# War Scroll Column 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 9 | **Condition:** complete

---

**9:1** And the priests shall-not defile their-garments with the-blood-of the-slain-of the-nations, but they-shall-stand-apart from-the-dead.

**9:2** They-shall-not draw-near to-the-slain lest-they-be-defiled by-their-impure-blood, for they are holy, and they-shall-not profane the-oil-of the-anointing-of their-priesthood with the-blood-of a-vain-nation.

**9:3** And the chief-priest shall-stand, and his brethren the-priests and the-Levites and all the-elders-of the-arrangement shall-be with-him, and they-shall-bless from-their-station the-God-of-Israel and all His works-of-truth.

**9:4** And they-shall-curse from-there Belial and all the spirits-of his-lot, and they-shall-answer and-say: "Blessed-be the-God-of-Israel for all His holy-purpose and His works-of-truth.

**9:5** And cursed-be Belial for-his-hostile-purpose, and may-he-be-execrated for his guilty-dominion. And cursed-be all the spirits-of his-lot for-their-wicked-purpose.

**9:6** May-they-be-execrated for all their-service-of-impurity. For they are the lot-of-darkness, but the lot-of-God is for eternal-light."

**9:7** And the chief-priest shall-strengthen the-hands-of the-men-of-battle, and he-shall-say to-them: "Be-strong and-be-courageous as-warriors-of-God!

**9:8** For this-is the-time-of-distress for-Israel, and the appointed-time-of-battle against-all the-nations. The lot-of-God is for-eternal-redemption,

**9:9** and for-the-annihilation-of every wicked-nation. And all the-nations-of vanity shall-be-no-more, and all the-peoples-of wickedness shall-be-put-to-shame."

**9:10** "Remember the-judgment-of Nadab and Abihu, the sons-of-Aaron, by-whose-judgment God showed-Himself-holy before the-eyes-of all the-people.

**9:11** But Eleazar and Ithamar He-confirmed in an-eternal-covenant-of-priesthood. Be-strong and fear-not!

**9:12** For they [the enemy] aim-at vanity-and-emptiness, and their-support is-as-though-it-were-not. They-know-not that from the-God-of-Israel is-all that-is and that-shall-be.

**9:13** He shall-act mightily in-His-battle today. For He-has-tested you-in-the-crucible of-distress. He-shall-raise the-banner before the-slain-of wickedness.

**9:14** And He-has-told you-of-old through the mysteries-of His-wondrous-might. The star-of Jacob shall-arise, and the scepter shall-spring-forth from-Israel.

**9:15** And he-shall-smite the-temples-of Moab and shall-destroy all the Sons-of-Sheth. And he-shall-descend from Jacob and shall-destroy the-survivor from the-city.

**9:16** And the-enemy shall-be a possession, and Israel shall-do valiantly. And by-the-hand-of Your anointed-ones, seers-of-appointed-times, You-have-told-us the times-of the-battles-of Your-hands.

**9:17** And our-camp is-holy and our-army has the-God-of-Israel, and the star-shall-go-forth from Jacob, and the scepter shall-arise from Israel."

---

*EMET notes: Column 9 is well preserved. Lines 10-11 reference Nadab and Abihu (Leviticus 10:1-3). Lines 14-15 quote the Star Prophecy of Numbers 24:17-19, a key messianic proof-text at Qumran. "Anointed ones, seers of appointed times" (line 16) refers to prophets as announcers of the divine war calendar.*
